Renders one row per artifact with verified/unverified/unknown badge (NON-color-only cues: icon + label), size, worker ID, and download button. Mission-level verification state computed honestly from the gateway's artifact.verified fields (NOT inferred from mission success).

ReplayTimeline component: client-side navigation of persisted event records. Step prev/next/first/last. Preserves actual causal seq order (sorts by seq ascending). Explicit 'Recorded-event replay; no mission is being re-executed' notice. Honest truncation notice when 100-event cap reached. NO tool execution, NO worker invocation, NO file mutation.

VerificationPanel (inline in ArtifactList): mission-level verification state mapping (VERIFIED / UNVERIFIED / UNKNOWN / NOT_AVAILABLE) based on the gateway's artifact.verified field ONLY. NEVER inferred from mission success, artifact presence, filename, or UI heuristics. No invented verification checks or timestamps.

artifacts.ts utility library: verificationStateFromArtifact() maps the gateway's verified boolean to a UI state. missionVerificationState() computes mission-level state. sanitizeDownloadFilename() strips path traversal, control chars, leading dots, limits length. detectPreviewKind() maps file extensions to safe preview kinds (HTML/SVG/XML/JS/CSS/JSON → text-source). escapeHtml() escapes dangerous chars for <pre> rendering. contentToDataUrl() converts content to base64 data URL for image/PDF preview.

ArtifactsSection updated: grid layout (Artifacts + Recorded-event Replay side-by-side on lg+). Honest InfoCards about verification originating from engine evidence and safe preview rules. Polls /v1/missions/{id}/events every 2.5s to populate the ReplayTimeline.

20 unit tests for artifacts library: verification state mapping (true→VERIFIED, false→UNVERIFIED, undefined→UNKNOWN, empty→NOT_AVAILABLE, mixed→UNVERIFIED), filename sanitization (path traversal, control chars, leading dots, empty, long), preview kind detection (safe + unsafe + unknown), escapeHtml, MIME mapping, data URL roundtrip, and the CRITICAL test U20: missionVerificationState NEVER infers VERIFIED from anything but artifact.verified.

open_findings.description: ArtifactPreview creates a Blob URL for download but does NOT revoke it via URL.revokeObjectURL(). Blob URLs persist for the lifetime of the document. For a session with many artifact downloads, this could leak memory. The browser will GC the Blob when the document unloads.
open_findings.action: Add a cleanup effect that revokes old Blob URLs when the artifact selection changes. Minor; tracked for G7-05 polish.

open_findings.description: Artifacts >64KB cannot be previewed or downloaded — the gateway inlines content only when ≤64KB and has no streaming endpoint in v1. The UI shows an honest 'Content not inline' notice with explanation.

known_limitations: Verification status comes ONLY from the gateway's artifact.verified field. The gateway computes it from verificationOk && verifiedPaths.has(path). No separate /verification endpoint exists in v1.
Artifact content is inlined only when ≤64KB. Larger artifacts cannot be previewed or downloaded through the gateway (no streaming endpoint in v1).
Replay is purely client-side navigation of recorded events. NO tool execution, NO worker invocation, NO file mutation. The 100-event cap means replay does NOT imply complete history.
Downloads use the inlined content via Blob + URL.createObjectURL. The Blob URL is bound to the browser session; no public artifact URLs, no Gateway API key exposure.
HTML/SVG/XML/JS/CSS/JSON are rendered as ESCAPED text source code — NEVER executed. No innerHTML, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Filenames are sanitized to basename only (strips path traversal, control chars, leading dots, limits length to 200 chars).
